scripts.predev:all: docker compose up -d && (which ollama >/dev/null && (curl -s http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags >/dev/null || (brew services start ollama 2>/dev/null || ollama serve >/dev/null 2>&1 &)) || true)
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "web,vision,media,video,socialflow,localbudd" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold,red.bold,yellow.bold,blue.bold" "npm run dev" "npm run worker:vision" "npm run worker:media" "npm run worker:video" "npm run worker:socialflow" "npm run worker:localbudd"
scripts.worker:vision: cd workers && set -a && [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env && set +a && if [ -f .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m vision.jobs.worker; else python3 -m vision.jobs.worker; fi
scripts.worker:media: cd workers && set -a && [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env && set +a && if [ -f .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m media_ai.jobs.worker; else python3 -m media_ai.jobs.worker; fi
scripts.worker:video: cd workers && set -a && [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env && set +a && if [ -f .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m media_ai.video.video_worker; else python3 -m media_ai.video.video_worker; fi
scripts.worker:socialflow: cd ../SocialFlow/backend && if [ -f ../venv/bin/python ]; then ../venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --port 8000 --reload; else uvicorn main:app --port 8000 --reload; fi
